evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite is positioned as an authority that enrolls a creator into a reviewer role upon a save — a rank-based allocation enacted by the test's assertion.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: The memory is framed as a vehicle whose sole purpose is to carry the enrollment assertion, reinforcing the authority-ranking move by subordinating the memory's existence to the rule it enacts.
